registry_purpose: Identify authoritative and standards-oriented sources for healthcare industry intelligence.

required_before_production_use: Confirm the URL resolves to the intended publication or official resource.
Capture the relevant section or passage.
Record publication, revision, or effective date where available.
Evaluate whether the source actually supports the intended claim.
source_review_policy.authority_rule: Prefer the responsible regulator or standards body for jurisdiction-specific requirements. Use international organizations for international context and technical organizations for the standards within their scope.

sources.title: Global strategy on digital health 2020–2027
limitations: Strategic guidance does not establish an individual customer's workflows or applicable local law.

sources.title: Digital health
limitations: Use the relevant underlying publication for detailed technical or policy claims.

sources.title: Diagnostics
limitations: Not a substitute for applicable laboratory regulations, product documentation, or test-specific instructions.

sources.title: Covered Entities and Business Associates
sources.organization: U.S. Department of Health and Human Services
limitations: Do not apply HIPAA roles or requirements without evaluating the actual organization, activities, and applicable rules.

sources.title: Laboratory quality management
limitations: Customer-specific quality systems, accreditation requirements, and local rules need separate verification.

sources.title: Medical devices: new regulations
limitations: Confirm current legal text, applicability, amendments, transition provisions, and product-specific status.

sources.title: Global Health Observatory
limitations: Check each indicator's definition, source, reference period, coverage, and comparability.

sources.title: Health at a Glance
sources.organization: Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development
sources.geographic_scope: OECD-focused, with scope varying by publication
limitations: Confirm the edition, included countries, definitions, and data reference years.

sources.title: FHIR specification
limitations: A standard's existence does not prove a customer system supports a particular version, profile, resource, or operation.

sources.title: Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.2
limitations: Determine the applicable legal standard and conformance target for the project separately.

sources.title: Cybersecurity Framework
sources.organization: National Institute of Standards and Technology
limitations: A framework is not proof of compliance, certification, or security effectiveness.

source_discovery_rules: Search for the responsible regulator when the question concerns a legal or regulatory obligation.
Prefer official standards bodies for technical standards and specifications.
Use peer-reviewed research and recognized professional organizations for evidence that requires scientific support.
Use official vendor documentation to establish a specific product's capabilities or integration requirements.
Use customer documents and authorized representatives to establish customer-specific workflows.
Use commercial reports cautiously; record methodology, date, geographic scope, and limitations.
Do not treat search snippets, AI-generated summaries, or an unreviewed URL as sufficient evidence for a high-impact claim.
